answer_2.quote: For objective evaluation, we compute the Mean Absolute Error of Pitch (MAE-P) and Mean Absolute Error of Energy (MAE-E) to assess the prosody of the synthesized speech. Additionally, we measure the Mel Cepstral Distortion (MCD) between the synthesized and ground-truth speech to evaluate synthesis quality.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we use the Dialogue-level Mean Opinion Score (DMOS). The evaluation is conducted by 20 graduate students specializing in speech... employing a 1-5 scale for Naturalness DMOS (N-DMOS) and Prosody DMOS (P-DMOS) to evaluate the quality and prosodic performance of the synthesized speech.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated synthesized speech on a 1-5 scale for naturalness and prosody.
